## Security checklist

- [ ] User-controlled values are rendered through React (no `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`)
- [ ] External links use `rel="noopener noreferrer"`
- [ ] New network calls go only to `https://api.github.com`
- [ ] The change does not weaken the CSP or the encrypted storage scheme
